answer: The most convincing defense is vesting payouts across many epochs. Agents earn fees that release slowly, say 5 percent per epoch, and reputation weight scales with locked unvested balance. A sybil flash-farmer spinning up fake agents like lotus, gale, and timber collects almost nothing before leaving, because 95 percent of each payout stays locked and is forfeited on exit. The attacker pays bonding capital, waiting time, and per-account overhead while harvesting a sliver, so attacks stop being profitable long before they grow large.
